text:
Maya: ParcelFlow POC wants a very small evidence handoff today. They requested: SOC2 controls snippet (storage + network), a signed pen-test attestation, either a presigned S3 upload or SFTP creds, and a clear Dedicated burst/overage line-item. Also asked whether Private deployment is an option for the POC.
Ravi: I can extract the SOC2 controls snippet. Should we include the control IDs or just plain language?
Maya: include IDs and a 1-paragraph plain-language summary. Mark any rows that reference production-only artifacts.
Tom: Legal/pen-test: I'll need vendor name + scan scope + POC contact to sign attestation. Also prefer S3 presign over SFTP for audit reasons.
Maya: vendor = BrightProbe. Contact = ops@parcelflow.com. Scope = external app + ephemeral staging range.
Elena: I can generate the presign 24h and also a short retention/deletion statement. Command: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/parcelflow/poc-5165.zip --expires-in 86400`
Kris: For Dedicated bursts: they are allowed but billable. Typical uplift shown on quotes is 20% of committed unit price for short bursts; we can provide a worked example. If they consider Private, that's a separate contract (longer lead time).
Maya: ParcelFlow asked if we can do 12h presign because their security team needs longer to collect artifacts. Can we do 48h?
Elena: We can issue 48h but will note retention. I can also provide an SFTP alternative (ephemeral user) if they insist.
Tom: Legal prefers presign. If you must SFTP, we need an audit log turned on and an SLA for deletion.
Ravi: I'll redact hostnames and replace IPs with placeholders in the excerpt. Also include EU residency statement — they said data must stay in EU for POC uploads.
Kris: For pricing: send me committed baseline (GPUs, hours). I will compute burst uplift and produce a short line-item.
Maya: baseline = 4x A10g for two days, expecting 6h/day burst.
Kris: I'll post numbers in a bit.
ComplianceBot: Reminder: when sharing SOC2 excerpts externally, remove raw logs and production-only diagrams. Include retention and redaction notices.
Elena: Presign URL (24h) created: https://s3-presign.example/pf-5165 (uploaded to thread). Holding for 48h reissue request.
Maya: Sent initial pack to ops@parcelflow.com with a 24h presign. They replied: "need 48h and confirmation we won't keep uploads more than 7 days".
Tom: 48h okay for POC. Deletion 7 days OK if we schedule automatic purge and include contact for exceptions.
Ravi: SOC2 snippet uploaded (redacted) and one-pager "what we share / what we don't" included.
Kris: Burst estimate posted: uplift 22% for short bursts, estimated additional cost for requested burst ~ $1,350 for the 2-day window. Attaching quote.
Maya: Great. ParcelFlow replied "please reissue presign 48h and we'll upload today".
Elena: Reissued 48h presign: https://s3-presign.example/pf-5165-48h (expires 48h). Noted retention: auto-delete scheduled in 7 days.
Tom: Pen-test attestation signed and uploaded to the share.
Maya: Sent consolidated reply to ParcelFlow with SOC2 snippet, signed attestation, 48h presign link, and the burst estimate.
ParcelFlow ops (via email): "Thanks, uploading now. One quick Q: can the POC be done on Dedicated trial capacity?"
Maya: I'll loop SalesOps for trial access. Closing thread after upload confirms. :thumbsup:
